title: NFL Football
description:
Chicago Bears at Green Bay Packers
The Packers host the Bears in NFL Week 5. Chicago won the last meeting, 31-27, at Soldier Field. Chicago quarterback Caleb Williams is out with a hamstring injury. Green Bay relies on QB Jordan Love, who has 1,041 passing yards and eight touchdowns.

title: NFL Football
description:
Detroit Lions at Arizona Cardinals
The Arizona Cardinals host the Detroit Lions at State Farm Stadium Week 5 NFL action. The Cardinals (1-3) have dropped three straight, including last week's 36-24 loss to the Giants, while the Lions (2-2) are coming off a 32-26 loss to the Panthers.

Los Angeles Dodgers at Milwaukee Brewers
